summary: Checking and building a mod, from the package panel to a build record tagging every preset it packed.

steps.does: The person asks for a Check of the focused mod.
Pins the mod and each preset it ships at its current entry.
Receives the request on the host; one Check and one Build at a time.
Supplies what each prerequisite last left (Check), or prepares them (Build).
Checks in a fresh worker within its deadline.
Records the Check: eligibility, omissions and identity keys.
The person asks for a Build.
Must hold, else the refusal names the one next step.
Cuts the eye plate for each body the mod needs.
Stages, packs once with WolvenKit, verifies and promotes exactly once.
Receives the promoted candidate, once, by candidate ID.
Records the Build with every preset's entry, each also tagged on its own stream.

demand: The person's request; the page follows the host's process.

faults.when: Settings, WolvenKit or the eye plate aren't ready.
A prerequisite fails on the game files.
A compiler or verifier gate fails; nothing is promoted.
The run passes its deadline; a stale prerequisite gets one retry with the remaining time.

latency: No multi-second wait without progress in place (a Build takes seconds to minutes).
budget.memory: Candidates live on disk; the build record carries only its ID and manifest summary.

invariants: Check and Build agree on the filtered snapshot and identities.
Nothing is promoted unless every gate passed.
A candidate is promoted at most once, even across a crash.
Every omitted layer or preset is reported in the record.
The authored mod and presets are never changed by a Check or Build.

x-friction.gap: Deadlines with the remaining time carried to a retry.
